title: A Seal Pup Is Weaned in 4 Days, the Shortest Childhood of Any Mammal

scenes.text: Some mammals raise their young in four days.
The hooded seal. A pup is born on drifting ice at about 24 kilograms, and its mother nurses it for only four days.
Her milk is about sixty percent fat. The pup roughly doubles its weight, to around 48 kilograms.
Then she leaves. No more milk, no more mother. It is the shortest nursing period of any mammal.
And the males? They inflate a black hood on the forehead, then push a red balloon out of one nostril.
It is a threat and a courtship display. Four days of childhood, then a life of balloons.

description:
Hooded seal pups are nursed for only about four days, the shortest lactation period of any mammal, and roughly double their weight in that time.
Adult males inflate a bi-lobed hood and a red balloon from the left nostril to threaten rivals and court females.
Which of these two facts surprised you more?
subject: hooded seal
first_comment: Four days of milk that is sixty percent fat, and then she is gone. Which animal has the strangest childhood?
